title: Running Commentary on Torah 56 — U-v-Yom Ha-Bikurim
hebrewTitle: פירוש רץ על תורה 56 — וביום הבכורים
author: Pettek Nanach
methodology: Three-layer line-by-line gloss: beginner = readable English prose with bracketed translations; intermediate = compact bilingual summary with citations; scholarly = terse Hebrew citation list. 15-segment coarse structure follows Rabbeinu's ois-marking (א–ט). Torah 56 is the major Shavuos drasha unpacking *'u-v-yom ha-bikurim b-hakrivchem minchah chadashah la-Hashem b-Shavuoseichem'* (Bamidbar 28:26). It threads together: (א) every Jew's bechina of malchus (revealed + concealed), (ב) malchus-as-ben-chorin = Mordechai/mar-dror for avodas Hashem via tochachah, (ג) arichus yamim drawn into malchus via Torah-b-peh (Torah = shem ha-Kadosh-Baruch-Hu = vessel to contain chiyus in middos), (ד-ג cont'd) hastarah-b-soch-hastarah = even there Hashem is clothed, and da'as reveals Him → oraysa machreshes, (ד) specifically sitrei-Torah hide in the deepest hastarah, (ה) malchus-d-kedushah (Mordechai) vs malchus-rish'ah (Haman/Amalek = me-aseif mammon / swallower of nitzotzos), (ו) parnasah-b-nekel + shalom both depend on da'as, (ז) Shavuos = mikveh of sha'ar-ha-chamishim = chesed elyon, (ח) man = ma'amar-patuach / ne'eman-pashut; ugah-mi-Mitzrayim with ta'am-man; (ט) the climactic 'eilu v-eilu divrei Elokim chayim' derivation: purifying the shamayim (= yadayim) via true anachah repairs ru'ach-ha-dofek → kabalas-diburim from shamayim = ra'amim → machlokes-l-shem-shamayim forbidden to denigrate. Peroration: the opening pasuk decoded clause-by-clause.

segments.beginner: When a person has a lev (heart), makom does not apply to him at all — on the contrary, he is the makom of the world. For Elokus is in the lev: 'Tzur levavi' (Psalms 73:26). And of Hashem yisborach it is said 'hineh makom iti' (Exodus 33:21) — He is the makom of the world, and the world is not His makom (Rashi; Bereshis Rabbah). One who has a lev Yisre'eli is therefore not fit to say 'this place is not good before me' — for makom does not apply to him at all; on the contrary, he is the makom of the world, and the world is not his makom.
segments.intermediate: **K'she-yesh la-adam lev — ein shayach etzlo makom klal** — ki **aderaba, hu mekomo shel olam.** Ki **ha-Elokus ba-lev** — "צוּר לְבָבִי" (תה' עג:כו). Ve-etzel Hashem yisborach ne'emar **"הִנֵּה מָקוֹם אִתִּי"** (שמ' לג:כא) — she-hu mekomo shel olam, ve-ein ha-olam mekomo (רש"י שם; ב"ר שם). **Nimtza, mi she-yesh lo lev Yisre'eli — ein ra'ui lo lomar she-makom zeh ein tov le-fanav** — ki ein shayach etzlo makom klal; aderaba, hu mekomo shel olam, ve-ein ha-olam mekomo.
segments.scholarly: [T2:56] לב = אלקות ("צור לבבי" תה' עג:כו). "הנה מקום אתי" (שמ' לג:כא) — מקומו של עולם; ב"ר סח:ט. ישראלי לא יאמר 'מקום זה לא טוב לי'.
